question.text: Under SEBI's framework for performance benchmarking of AIFs (Circular SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 read with the June 12, 2020 circular), any association of AIFs that notifies one or more Benchmarking Agencies must represent at least what percentage of the number of AIFs?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI circulars on disclosure standards for AIFs, 'any association of AIFs which in terms of membership, represents at least 33 percent of the number of AIFs, may notify one or more Benchmarking Agencies.' IVCA meets this threshold and has notified agencies such as CRISIL, NSE and Preqin. The Trap: Options A (10%), B (25%), and D (50%) are plausible regulatory thresholds — 10% and 25% echo Cat III concentration limits and 50% echoes quorum rules — but the specific benchmarking-association threshold in the SEBI circulars is 33%. Note: Per page 222, an AIF that has completed one year of operations reports data and enters an agreement with the relevant benchmarking agency; the contract follows on-time reporting rather than a fixed 'within one year of First Close' deadline.
